description: Defines helper functions for managing time domain resources in TDD operation within the ocudu namespace, including generation of candidate lists for PDSCH and PUSCH resources, and calculation of minimum symbols for PDSCH considering PDCCH configurations.

methods.name: generate_k1_candidates
methods.description: Generates a list of available k1 candidates for PDSCH-to-HARQ timing for TDD operation, based on TDD configuration and minimum k1 value.

methods.name: calculate_minimum_pdsch_symbol
methods.description: Calculates the minimum symbol index available for PDSCH, considering PDCCH reservation.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pdsch_td_res_list
methods.description: Creates a list of PDSCH time domain resource allocations considering available symbols, based on TDD config, cyclic prefix, and minimum symbol.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pusch_td_res_list
methods.description: Generates a list of UE dedicated PUSCH time domain resource allocations for TDD, based on TDD config, cyclic prefix, and minimum k2.
